newsitem.title: USA: Kinetic Concepts loses Premier bid.
newsitem.headline: Kinetic Concepts loses Premier bid.

text.p: Kinetic Concepts Inc said on Wednesday Premier Purchasing Partners LP advised the company its bid to be the primary supplier for the newly combined group was awarded to another vendor.
But the company said it expected Premier would continue to represent about 10 percent of Kinetic's revenues.

Because Kinetic supplied about 30 percent to 35 percent of Premier's business, and facilities within the group were not committed to do business with the group's primary vendor, Kinetic said it was difficult to predict the ultimate effect of the new agreement on revenues and operating profits.

Raymond Hannigan, chief executive officer, said: "We remain confident that the company will meet its overall growth expectations for 1997. Our track record in building and maintaining hospital relationships indicates that we will be able to aggressively compete for much of the group's business." The company was not immediately available to comment further.
